invariants.rationale: The method always returns the result of HoodieListData.lazy(records), which should not be null.
records is the method parameter and is passed directly to HoodieListData.lazy.
HoodieListData.lazy returns a HoodieListData, so result should be of this type.
Assuming HoodieListData.lazy wraps the list without modification, the element count should match the input list.
If HoodieListData.lazy provides a view over the original list, collecting its contents should equal the input list.
